notes: §1985:IX.2.8.2 prints I-O-CONTROL. [[RERUN ON {file-name-1 | implementor-name-1} EVERY {integer-1 RECORDS OF file-name-2 | integer-2 CLOCK-UNITS | condition-name-1}] ... [SAME [RECORD] AREA FOR file-name-3 {file-name-4} ...] ... .] (the printed page, IX-15, rendered: the ON phrase carries no bracket here, and file-name-4 is in braces). ioControlParagraph and ioControlClause parse the paragraph at 85 with rerunClause and sameClause (EVERY, OF, AREA and FOR optional words); BindIoControl hands each SAME clause to ScreenSameOperands, which refuses fewer than two files and a name that is no file of the program (COBOL2738, the witness), and the RERUN clauses to ScreenRerunClauses, which requires the ON phrase in each of the three forms this format prints (COBOL6530), file-name-2 after RECORDS (COBOL6496) and a switch condition-name-1, and refuses END OF REEL over an indexed file (COBOL6529); ScreenParagraphPeriods holds the paragraph to its one closing period (COBOL3407, COBOL3408), VisitUnrecognizedClause refuses any other clause (COBOL1970) and VisitApplyCommitClause the 2023 APPLY COMMIT clause (COBOL0900). Probed at 85 over indexed files: the three RERUN forms with SAME AREA and SAME RECORD AREA clauses compile and run (the record area is shared), as do the paragraph with no clause and the forms with the optional words dropped; 20 malformed paragraphs are each refused. The witness refuses SAME AREA FOR F1, a clause that names one file.

next.reason: 1985 indexed I-O-CONTROL: [RERUN ON file-name/implementor-name EVERY {integer RECORDS OF file-name | integer CLOCK-UNITS | condition-name}] … [SAME [RECORD] AREA FOR file-name-3 {file-name-4} …] … . The paragraph survives, so REMOVED is wrong: §2023:12.4.6.2 keeps I-O-CONTROL with apply-commit-clause and same-clause ("The apply-commit and same clauses may be specified in any order"), and §2023:12.4.6.4.2 keeps SAME AREA (Format 1) and SAME RECORD AREA (Format 2). RERUN occurs nowhere in the 2023 text, so a 1985 program with a RERUN clause is refused; APPLY COMMIT is added. Compile-time only.
